prompt:
Vertical 9:16 marketing clip, 12–15s, no talking head.
0–3s HOOK: bold on-screen text "1 claim. 7 containers." → one sticky note claim slides into frame.
3–8s: claim fans into 7 labeled cards (Thread A / Thread B / Image / Card / Reply / Email / Soft CTA).
8–12s: calendar icon fades; library stack stays — text "Process > backlog".
End card: "Claim library. Not a content calendar. @ramanpal"
Style: light bg, crisp SaaS UI motion, teal accents, readable on mobile. Soft UI clicks only.

竖版 9:16 营销短片，12-15 秒，无出镜人物。

3-8 秒：便签展开成 7 张带标签卡片（Thread A / Thread B / Image / Card / Reply / Email / Soft CTA）。
8-12 秒：日历图标淡出；资料库堆栈保留 — 文字“Process > backlog”。
尾页：“Claim library. Not a content calendar. @ramanpal”
风格：浅色背景，利落 SaaS UI 动效，青色点缀，移动端清晰易读，仅柔和 UI 点击音效。
